verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is an audio/video record, convert and stream tool. Document conversion that preserves layout, fonts, images and tables is outside its product category, and no evidence shows it converts documents. Its media-format fidelity (e.g., streamcopy) is a different axis and does not transfer.

support.subject: As a power user, document conversion preserves layout, fonts, images, and tables rather than flattening them
